desc: Ideation: reduce to no-delete + per-negative-value deletion; derive transformed prefix-sum formula A[t] = PS[t] - x·cntX[t]; within-block pairs dominated by no-delete answer; only cross-block pairs matter.
Prove only negative x need consideration (deleting non-negative values is dominated by no-delete).
Implement prefix sums PS and no-delete Kadane max subarray sum.
Implement iterative min/max segment trees over PS with range-min and range-max queries.

Group negative value occurrences; for each x (skip if occ(x)==n), sweep blocks between occurrences maintaining running minA of A[i], compute cross-block candidates via range-max query over valid j positions.
Verify solution against provided examples and edge cases (n=1, all-same-negative, zeros, consecutive occurrences, all positives); validate block-boundary logic and segment tree query correctness.
